findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 列出競爭對手：Cisco 長期主導，另有 Dell/EMC、Extreme、HPE（已收購 Juniper）、Huawei、Nvidia 與白牌廠商；並指新進入者與替代技術可能造成降價壓力。
findings.excerpt: The arrival of new market entrants and the rapid adoption of alternative technologies may create downward pricing pressure. Such shifts could result in lost sales and materially harm our operating results and financial condition.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：競爭已造成降價壓力、可能損失份額；AI Ethernet 產品需與較成熟的 InfiniBand 及他廠 AI Ethernet 競爭，品牌認知尚未廣泛建立。
findings.excerpt: In addition, we have not established broad market awareness or acceptance of our AI Ethernet products that will compete against more established InfiniBand products or against the AI Ethernet products of other competitors.

findings.claim: IDC：1Q26 Nvidia 成為資料中心乙太網路交換器營收第一，Arista 資料中心份額 20.7%
findings.excerpt: NVIDIA’s Spectrum-X platform, an end-to-end AI networking solution that integrates Spectrum Ethernet switches with BlueField DPUs and NVIDIA LinkX cables, purpose-built for large-scale GPU clusters, has emerged as the preferred network interconnect for large-scale AI training, winning significant traction with hyperscalers and AI-native cloud providers building AI factories. Arista

findings.claim: IDC：2Q26 Arista 資料中心份額 18.7%、整體 13.4%；Nvidia 20.4%
findings.excerpt: Arista Networks: Arista’s revenues grew 37.6% YoY in 2Q26 to $2.5B, per IDC, with the company holding a 13.4% share of the total Ethernet switch market and 18.7% in the datacenter segment.

findings.claim: Meta 與 Nvidia 簽多年 Spectrum-X 乙太網路部署合約，Arista 股價下跌
findings.excerpt: Arista Shares Drop 2.9% After Meta-Nvidia Multi-Year Spectrum-X Networking Deal - ANET News | Rallies

note: IDC 2026 Q1/Q2 份額（Nvidia 於 1Q26 超越 Arista 成資料中心乙太網路交換器第一；Arista 資料中心份額 1Q26 20.7%→2Q26 18.7%）及 Meta–Nvidia Spectrum-X 多年合約，僅見搜尋摘要轉述，未讀原頁，列為 clues。未找到具名取代 Arista 的設計案。 線索 3 條，程式核實 3 條
